summary: Silent data-integrity violation: the frozen fold_assignment_v1.csv was generated against a stale split snapshot, causing 372 Test patients to leak into the fold and 372 Development patients to be dropped.

regeneration.deterministic_evidence: Two independent runs of build_oof_folds(...,seed=42,k=5) against the corrected manifest + frozen split produced byte-identical CSVs (SHA 989d5dc9...)

promotion_decision: User selected option (a) on 2026-07-25: copy fold_assignment_v2.csv over fold_assignment_v1.csv, write _SUPERSEDED.md marker. CLI path unchanged.
validator_enforcement: The P2-02A stability probe (algorithm/p1/stability/probe.py) now calls validate_frozen_training_inputs as the frozen_input_validation stage. Any future drift between fold and Development set short-circuits the probe before CUDA is loaded and before any Test patient is read.

incident_evidence.note: Detailed receipts with per-fold per-class counts are preserved under algorithm/artifacts/ (gitignored). The on-patch machine can verify via algorithm/artifacts/p1_integrity_incident_20260725/incident_receipt.json and algorithm/artifacts/p1_v2_candidate/fold_v2_integrity_receipt.json.

patient_id_policy: No patient IDs are recorded in this receipt. The invalid_fold and replacement_fold were generated from a fixed, frozen split; their integrity is verifiable by SHA + counts, not by patient-level detail.
